rows.notes: Legacy lifecycle: initialize/initialized handshake, tools/list without cache metadata, per-call params carry name and arguments only. The corpus proves transparent pass-through and identical policy decisions with the stateless revision.

Stateless lifecycle: server/discover, per-request _meta carrying protocol version/client identity/trace context, list cache metadata (resultType/ttlMs/cacheScope), and MRTR input_required/inputResponses pass-through. Proves transparent pass-through only; ToolFence does not implement or claim these higher-level capabilities.

Platform-neutral Broker IPC abstraction implemented with user-scoped Named Pipe support and strict private credential storage verification; interactive approval exercises owner-scoped access and fail-closed security invariants on Windows.
Streamable HTTP transport is not implemented. Requires a dedicated topology, authorization, and threat-model review before any claim. Tracked in ROADMAP v0.5-alpha.
